name: GULL_WIND_BEHAVIOR_VERTICAL_REACTION_NORM_PREOUTCOME_V1

source.native_study: Sage et al. 2019, Texel, 2015-2017, 21 herring gull/9 lesser black-backed gull tagged; 29 birds with qualified archived trips
source.data_origin: Pre-processed subset of trips largely terrestrial, already annotated weather/orographic lift and accelerometer-derived class; cannot infer global population-wide flight behavior.
source.duplicate_boundary: This source may overlap later HG_TEXEL and LBBG_TEXEL Movebank/Zenodo exports: never count same original tracks as independent replicate.

ecological_question: After matching same individual, coarse location and accelerometer-derived flight mode, does the wind regime provide transferable information about within-day centered vertical use on independent days?
novelty_vs_original_paper: This is a new individual-specific vertical probability distribution and held-out transfer question, NOT rerunning Sage et al's orographic route selection or soaring probability result.

preoutcome_selection.species_labels: Group by native project code without remapping until metadata confirms species designation; no pooling different native projects
preoutcome_selection.gps_thinning: first (earliest UTC timestamp) qualifying flight-speed+class source event in each unique device×UTC day×5-minute bin; wind missing does not change selected event
preoutcome_selection.wind_regime: Within native project × calendar year, calculate 25th and 75th percentile of equal-weighted BIRD-DAY median wspeed (m/s), after fixed GPS thinning; label each bird-day low if <= Q25 and high if >=Q75, middle excluded.
preoutcome_selection.wind_values: Only finite wspeed>=0; if missing selected record contributes to flight counts but not bird-day wind median, and cannot contribute to conditional cells

eventual_endpoint_if_gate_passes.reference: same individual other day +same 5km cell+same flight mode, wind-pooled distribution of centered altitude bins
eventual_endpoint_if_gate_passes.contextual: same individual other day +same 5km cell+same flight mode+same wind regime, alt bins
eventual_endpoint_if_gate_passes.target: day-median centered altitude_adl above digital terrain; each day median estimated from heldout day, only session-shape matching, not absolute altitude prediction
eventual_endpoint_if_gate_passes.natural_units: daily within flight AGL; source-derived altitude_adl native metres with [-300,3000] gate
eventual_endpoint_if_gate_passes.no_tuning: No change to support, grid, bins or wind bins after altitude opened.
eventual_endpoint_if_gate_passes.primary_metric: heldout session mean log P(z|wind,mode,bird,cell)/P(z|mode,bird,cell), equally aggregate days per bird, then birds; both models use identical target events and 0.5 counts per bin.
eventual_endpoint_if_gate_passes.evidence_criteria: Positive mean held-out gain beyond a day-level wind-block null and >=10 eligible birds, separately for flap and soar with two-test Holm; unavailable mode counts as placeholder p=1
eventual_endpoint_if_gate_passes.causal_boundary: Wind annotations and device-specific errors are observational; wind reaction norms are associations, not causal ecological mechanisms. Soar/flap classes are predicted from accelerometer and may be misclassified.

alternative_confirmation.note: Independent Movebank study from Zeebrugge; raw GPS+accelerometer 2013–2022, wind not yet joined. Do not treat as existing environmental analysis; source metadata only.

next: Run outcome-blind source-support and report exact project/year, year-specific wind thresholds, eligible birds for each class. Only then freeze and open altitude outcomes. If no class >=10 birds, stop this endpoint without rescue.
